Hi! I'm Nicole and I'm a complementary health therapist based in Chelsea, London. I specialise in reflexology treatments, therapeutic and deep tissue massage, and circulo-lymphatic massage. I suffer from scoliosis and therefore chronic back pain.  I decided to try the viral Chinese exercises as they are meant to help with releasing fascia, stimulating circulation and lymphatic flow, and helping with stress reduction. So far I have seen a vast improvement in my back pain and leg heaviness and discomfort ( I have varicose veins). I have also noticed that my energy levels have improved. I would definitely encourage you to start doing these exercises daily which only take about 8 minutes(please check with your doctor before starting any exercises). 
Please follow my instagram @thatlondontherapist for more exercises and self care inspiration. Please send me a DM on instagram if you would like to see me for a reflexology treatment or a massage. Take care of yourself, Nicole
